docs.title: Modding Wiki
docs.text:
Every Cobblemon mod by shiero, documented in one place.

Each mod keeps its documentation in its own repository and publishes it here, under its own section. This page is just the front door.

docs.title: Cobblemon Routes
docs.text:
Physical routes generated during worldgen that connect the world's structures, signposted and named like the games (Route 3: Plains Forest). Turns any Cobblemon world into a classic linear RPG.

MC 1.21.1 · Cobblemon 1.7.3 · Fabric + NeoForge

docs.title: Cobblemon Nuzlocke & Soul Link (coming)
docs.text:
The full Hardcore-Nuzlocke ruleset: per-zone first-encounter capture lock, permadeath, mandatory nicknames, a shiny clause, starter randomiser and level caps. All of it works solo.

On top of that, Soul Link: the co-op mode where you link parties with friends and share fates — when one linked Pokémon dies, so do its soulmates.

Currently being split out of Routes into its own mod. See #122. Until it ships, its documentation lives in the Routes wiki.

docs.title: Reporting bugs and requesting features
docs.text:
Every mod has its own Discord forum channels, and a bot turns posts into GitHub issues automatically. You don't need a GitHub account: post in the mod's forum and that's it.

The bots live in intake-bots, one per project.

This wiki replaces the old per-mod wikis

Each mod used to have its own wiki at its own URL (cobblemon-routes-wiki, cobblemon-picnic-wiki, cobblemon-ditto-hms). There is now a single one: manucruzleiva.github.io/mod-wiki/. Old links published on Modrinth and CurseForge should be updated.
